description: Uitdagingen-curation (Wonen & Werken): streng stedelijk-alleen, flexwoningen dicht en de stilte-tegenbeeld.

scenarios.name: Housing only within existing urban area
scenarios.description: Drops the exception composition — kernrandzone (FR-WN-04) and the three uitbreiding-woningbouw rules (FR-WN-07/08/09) — leaving only the stedelijk gebied opening: the strictest anti-verstedelijking reading.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-WN-01 (art. 9.3) carries the verstedelijkingsverbod of het Landelijk gebied; its tenzij-structure is operationalized by the inclusion composition, which this variant removes (strictest reading).

scenarios.name: Flexwoningen route closed
scenarios.description: Drops FR-WN-08 (art. 9.14a, one-time temporary expansion up to 50 flexwoningen per kern) — the temporary-housing lever disappears.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-WN-08 (art. 9.14a) is the flexwoningen exception; this variant documents dropping that specific lever.

scenarios.name: Stiltegebied protection widened: markers hard, attention at 1 km
scenarios.description: Executes FR-WN-11 (stiltegebied) and FR-WN-12 (aandachtsgebied) as hard exclusions and widens the attention zone by 1 km — a hypothetical quietness-buffer for housing.

basis.rationale: Arts. 9.27/9.29 are rekening-houden markers without spatial consequence in the baseline; a 1 km housing buffer around stiltegebieden is not cited anywhere — this hypothetical measures its cost.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: the stiltegebied designations (NC-WN-11/NC-WN-12) are cited, the hard enforcement and the 1 km widening are the scenario's own parameters.
